name: civitai-app-starters
description: Starter templates and shared SDK for building apps on Civitai.

comment-overrides: Every FIRST-PARTY @civitai/* package MUST be listed here as workspace:*.
This is what makes a release possible at all. The starters pin published
caret ranges (^0.32.0) on purpose so a `tiged`'d copy installs from npm
for external devs -- but inside this workspace those ranges must never
reach the registry, because `changeset version` rewrites them to versions
that are not published YET. An override rewrites the specifier BEFORE it
is recorded in pnpm-lock.yaml, so the lockfile importer entry reads
`specifier: workspace:*` and does NOT churn when changesets bumps the
caret -- which is the only reason `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` can
pass on the Version Packages PR. Omit a package here and the release
deadlocks: the lockfile can only be regenerated after publish, publish
needs the merge, the merge needs a green frozen-lockfile install.
